$comment: Read-only data-source catalog for the discovery agent. Each entry is a structured, no-key (or public-key) REST source queried directly — no managed local service. get_data_source_desc renders this; get_data_source dispatches to the matching adapter in data_sources.py.

sources.name: arXiv
sources.description: Preprints in physics, math, CS, and related fields. Query by title/abstract/author/all.

query_params.query: string — arxiv search query, e.g. 'all:transformers' or 'ti:diffusion'

sources.output: list of {title, url, authors, summary, published}

sources.name: Crossref
sources.description: Scholarly metadata and DOI resolution across publishers.
sources.output: list of {title, url, container_title, issued, authors}

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.description: Open scholarly index: works, authors, institutions, concepts. Full-text search.
sources.output: list of {title, url, publication_year, cited_by_count, doi}

sources.name: Wikipedia
sources.description: Encyclopedic entity descriptions and full-text search.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance
sources.description: Current quote and 1-day OHLC for equities, ETFs, forex, crypto, and indices. Ticker conventions: 'AAPL', 'BTC-USD', 'EURUSD=X', '^GSPC'. No key, but unofficial (may rate-limit — retry once).
sources.output: {symbol, name, currency, exchange, price, previous_close, open, day_high, day_low, volume, market_time}

sources.name: GitHub
sources.description: Repository and code search across public GitHub.

query_params.query: string — repo search query, e.g. 'terminal tui in:name'

sources.output: list of {full_name, url, description, stars, language, updated_at}
